name: EPIC 211406716

text.card: A red giant 6,776 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.35 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,836 K at its surface.
